title: Nyang Artikulat Geupileh Saboh .
intro: Lam bayangan gunong teumpat tutoe haba ilahi jitron, iman saboh bansa meugoyang-goyang dimiyueb kilat meuh. Saboh jiwa, nyang geubri bakat deungon fasih peugah haba, geudong seubagoe pendukung keu misi nyang leubeh rayeuk, namun geuhadapi saboh momen ujian nyang mendalam. Watèë utusan njang ka geupiléh njan geuék u ateuëh teumpat suci, tokoh njoë teutap di likôt, geumeulakèë bak saboh bansa njang hana teuntram. Soe kheueh jiwa nyang teuga nyoe nyang su jih jibeudôh jilawan seumah beurala?
clues: Lon geu pileh le Allah jeut keu nabi, padahai kisah lon kayem geu peugah di samping nyang laen.
Lon dikirem keu sidroe penguasa tiran, tapi peran lon nakeuh untuk mendukung, kon untuk memimpin.
Lon na bakat keu fasih peugah haba, dan tutoe haba lon meukeusud keu peuleumoh hate.
Watèë rakan ulôn beurangkat keu janji suci, ulôn tinggai keu bimbing saboh bansa njang hana teuntram.
Lam hana saba awaknyan, awaknyan jipeugot saboh patong nibak hiasan-hiasan awaknyan, dan ulôn meulakée bak awaknyan mangat teutap seutia ubak Allah.
Rakan ulôn njan djiwoë dan djidjak drop ulôn, teuma ulôn peutrang bahwa rakjat njan ka djikuasa ulôn dan karab djipoh ulôn; Ulôn hana jitamong lam kawan ureuëng nyang jeuhet.
arabic: ثُمَّ بَعَثْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِم مُّوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse: Then We sent after them Moses and Aaron to Pharaoh and his establishment with Our signs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a criminal people. (10:75)
